title: feat(automation)!: hold, arm and run flows by (package, name), so two packages' same-named flows are each armed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBACaR2yPzyA9bofAfNpzFDY)_

Part of #31696
Supersedes #32091

Narrowing: yes
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` teaches no member this PR narrows (no resolver-less composition, no credential save under a shared name). One parenthetical there goes stale: its `subflow` row says a two-holder name is "an older clash, never armed". The refusal that row teaches is unchanged (a bare or package-less caller is refused, naming both), but such a clash is now armed per slot. Install still refuses to create one until PR-3, so the wording is carried to PR-3, which makes two holders an authorable state.

**The widening beside the narrowing.** A sealed clash (two installed packages that ship one flow name) moves from "arming neither" to "each package's flow armed in its own slot", reached only by `(package, name)`. That is carry-in 1 of the card (6760047493). The two narrowings, both declared in the committed changeset with its ADR-0087 marker, are: (1) a composition with no flow-name resolver used to arm one holder of a two-holder name by precedence (a pick) and now refuses the bare name; (2) a save or publish that would write or remove a stored flow credential under a two-holder name is now refused (409, naming both). The epic records (1) as covered by carry-ins 6760047493 and 6729233545, red line 2 and ADR-0150 D3 (6764658726). The seat ordered (2) as the epic condition of split A (6764953109).

ADR-0150 child B (flow family), **PR-1a** of the card's three parts. The seat split the old PR-1 (#32091) under the 3,000-line threshold (ruling 6764953109). This PR covers the engine slots, arming, R8 stored runs, the activation ledger with M2, and S3's refusal. **PR-1b** carries R9: the credential channel's per-package index, reads and stamped writes, M3's scoped writes, and `readsByPackage = true`. It opens from this branch after this PR lands. PR-2 binds the trigger packages and the inbound hook per slot. PR-3 adds the `/automation` doors, the `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` switch, dogfood, and `Fixes`. This PR does not touch `bare-name-one-holder.ts`. The ADR amendment's dated line ("the engine arms one flow per bare name until this card lands") is closed by PR-3, which lands the card.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：自动化引擎按「(包, 名称)」持有、启用和运行流程。两个包的同名流程各自启用，不再一个都不启用。挂起的运行带上了包。启动期间不会把无包的禁用开关绑给先到的包。共享名下的凭据读写一律失败关闭。
- 为什么改：这是 ADR-0150 子卡 B（flow）的第一部分（拆分后的 PR-1a）。命名空间开关（PR-3）翻开之前，引擎必须先能并存同名流程，而且不能替调用方挑一个。
- 风险与回滚：名称只有一个持有者时，键、日志和返回都与改前相同。有两处收窄：没有解析器的组合不再替两包同名流程挑一个；共享名下改写凭据的保存返回 409。回滚直接 revert。
- 先看：`engine.ts` 的 `placeFlowSlot`、`sealFlowHolders` 和凭据源包装，`flow-activation-projection.ts`，`flow-credential-channel.ts` 的共享名拒绝。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/services/service-automation && npx vitest run src/flow-slots-per-package.test.ts src/flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts src/flow-credential-channel.test.ts`（应为 3 个文件全部通过）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## Patch round (contract review FAIL 6764624467 on #32091 at e714e9b9)

| Item | What changed | Pin (ablation) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **M1** one declaration | Title carries `!`. Body and changeset agree: `Narrowing: yes`, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with the widening beside it, ADR-0087 marker, `Skills-docs:` above. The stale sentences are gone: Q4 now says what the tree does (S1), "byte for byte" is limited to keys, log lines and answers (stored rows gain `flow_package`, as the changeset says), and the public-name list is complete (below). The rolling upgrade across a sealed clash is a declared limit, not a narrowing (epic answer 6764658726 item 1). Full dogfood ran on the final head (Verification). | n/a |
| **M2** no bind during boot | `AutomationEngine.sealFlowHolders()`, called by the plugin at `kernel:bootstrapped`, when the registry seals its holders. Before the seal, a second holder never binds a package-less disable row to the first. It calls `FlowActivationProjection.refusePackagelessBind`, which reads the row as first read under two holders: both off, one warning, never bound later. The durable bind runs only after the seal. In PR-1 nothing reaches it, because install refuses a new holder. Its first caller is PR-3's genuine install. | Engine: `boot convergence, two installed packages (alpha first / beta first)`. Real kernel over SQLite: `M2: … (installed-after)` (a code package, then an installed one), `(installed-both)`, `(installed-both-reversed)`. The three post-seal bind cases now seal first. **A9** |
| **M3** R9 writes | Split A: R9 by package is PR-1b's. Here the channel stays at main's by-name reads and writes. Under a name two packages hold, `store()` and `promote()` refuse any write that would write, update or delete a row (`PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, 409, naming every holder) before anything is written. A save that touches no row still saves. | SQLite channel: `a save or a publish that would update or delete another package's row is refused, naming both; nothing changes`. **A11** (store), **A12** (promote) |
| **S1** Q4 amendment | Stated in "What changes" below. The amendment is recorded on the card (6764658726 item 4, 6764686113). | (round 2's pins) |
| **S2** approvals' bare reads | Declared limit, carried by PR-2: in a run of a shared slot, `plugin-approvals` still reads its flow by bare name for a send-back, a batch's map item and the step labels, so those answer 409 (fail closed). Passing the run's package needs a run-to-package read across two packages and would push this PR past 3,000 lines. | n/a (declared) |
| **S3** unscoped source | Seat ruling: refuse. `FlowCredentialSource.readsByPackage`. A source that does not declare it is never asked for a slot of a shared name: `holds` answers `true` (never "no credential"), and `resolve` / `held` throw `FlowCredentialUnresolvableError`, naming the flow and its package. The in-tree channel does not declare it until PR-1b, so every shared slot's credential read is refused. Declared in the changeset beside `SuspendedRunStore`. | Engine: `S3: a source that reads by name alone is never asked …` (a stand-in, and the real channel). **A13** |
| **N1** | An `override` arm with no `holder` under two slots names no package, and `placeFlowSlot` refuses it, naming both. It never takes the loader's by-name owner. | In `an environment-authored body … is refused`. **A14** |
| **N2** | Accepted deviation: a slot whose entry vanished while another package still holds the name lingers until the next `metadata:reloaded`. That happens only through a runtime mutation of an installed package, which PR-3's doors own. | n/a |
| **N3** | `canBindPackageless`'s docblock now says what a package-less row does once the name is shared. | n/a |
| **N4** | The stale body claims are covered under M1. | n/a |

## What changes

- **`flow-slots.ts`** (new): `FlowSlot` and `FlowSlotTable`. A slot is `(packageId | null, name)`. Its key is the bare name while it is the name's only slot, and `PACKAGE/NAME` (`qualifiedFlowKey`) while two or more slots hold the name. A package arriving for a name held only by a package-less slot adopts that slot (D4). A run carries its slot key, so a `subflow` or `map` child resolves names from its own package.
- **`engine.ts`**: every per-flow record is filed under the slot key, and `registerFlow` places each arm in a slot (`placeFlowSlot`). When a second holder arrives, the first holder's records move to its qualified key, and they move back when it leaves.
  - The bare doors (`execute`, `getFlow`, `toggleFlow`, `unregisterFlow`, `withdrawFlow`, `getFlowVersionHistory`, `rollbackFlow`, the credential reads) answer a two-holder name with `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), naming both. They never pick.
  - The slot doors serve each holder. `subflow` and `map` resolve a shared name from the caller's package. E1 (#31677) is kept for every arm that names no slot.
  - Triggers decline a shared slot until PR-2, with one warning per slot.
- **`flow-precedence.ts`**: for two or more shipping packages, precedence returns one winner per package (`FlowPrecedenceWinner.holder`). An environment body over such a name overlays neither, with one warning.
- **Activation ledger** (`@objectstack/core` `MetadataActivationStoreOptions.addressing`; flows use `'package-and-name'`, every other type keeps `'name'`): switching one package's flow writes that package's row.
  - **Q4, as amended (S1):** a package-less disable row first read while two packages hold the name keeps off every holder that has no row of its own, with one warning, and is never bound later. This replaces Q4 A's "both packages' own bodies arm" for disable rows. The operator's remedy is `toggleFlowSlot`, which writes that package's own row.
  - A package-less row read while one package held the name binds to that package only at a second holder's arrival **after the seal** (M2). The bind is durable and awaited, and a failed write keeps both off.
- **R8, `sys_automation_run.flow_package`**: a stored run names its package and resumes only on its own package's flow (`flow-slot-run-store.ts`, `run-resume.ts`, `dag-traversal.ts`).
- **R9 in this PR** is fail-closed only: shared-slot credential reads are refused (S3), and shared-name credential writes that would touch a row are refused (M3). PR-1b reads and writes by package.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`declinesStoredRow`)**: a stored flow row is judged against every package that ships the name, so a declared `.custom` override is no longer dropped when another same-named shipper registers first.

**New public names** (Q5 names as ruled, plus what the rounds added):
- `@objectstack/service-automation`: `qualifiedFlowKey`, `type FlowSlot`.
- `AutomationEngine`: `executeSlot`, `getFlowSlot`, `getFlowSlots`, `flowSlotKey`, `toggleFlowSlot`, `withdrawFlowSlot`, `packagedFlowSlotOwner`, `getRunFlow`, `flowKeyOfRun`, `flowActivationBinds`, `sealFlowHolders`.
- Fields: `FlowContender.holder`, `FlowPrecedenceWinner.holder`, `SuspendedRun.flowPackage`, `RunRecord.flowPackage`, `FlowCredentialSource.readsByPackage`.
- Widened: `PackagedFlowSource` and `FlowCredentialSource` take an optional package, and `FlowCredentialChannel`'s constructor takes an optional shared-name reader.
- `@objectstack/core`: `MetadataActivationStoreOptions`, `MetadataActivationRowAddressing`, `MetadataActivationWriteOptions.adoptPackageless`.
- No new error code.

**Declared limits (until PR-1b / PR-2 / PR-3):**
- R9 by package (PR-1b). Until then a shared slot's credential reads are refused, and so are shared-name writes that would touch a row.
- Triggers decline a shared slot, and `plugin-approvals`' bare-name reads in a shared-slot run answer 409 (S2). Both go to PR-2.
- A rolling upgrade across a sealed clash fails such a paused run as unresumable on an older replica. It never continues on the other package's flow.
- The listing faces list one row per slot (Q2 A).
- The S4 report lists neither the Q4 rows nor the sealed-clash flows yet (PR-3).
- The epic's mixed-version ledger read item (6764387209 item 2) is due before PR-3 flips the switch.

## Tests

- `flow-slots-per-package.test.ts` (new, 35 tests): the slot table, both holders armed, the bare refusal at every door, subflow resolution from the caller's package, the move back, E1 kept, the trigger decline, the ledger per slot (M2 boot convergence, post-seal bind, failed bind, never-bound-later), R8 resume by package, the credential source asked by package only when it reads by package (S3), and precedence.
- `flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts`: the forced #31754 rewrite from round 1, plus three real-kernel M2 boot orders over SQLite with the activation ledger attached.
- `flow-credential-channel.test.ts`: the M3 shared-name refusal over a real ObjectQL on SQLite, with rows stamped per package as the boot backfill stamps them.
- Dogfood, two fixtures this change made stale (red on the first full battery, fixed here): `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts` asserted the boot armed neither flow of the held name; it now reads each package's flow by slot and the bare name refused (409, naming both). `flow-credential-channel.dogfood.test.ts` tests 9 and 10 took the channel class from the live source's constructor, which is the engine's slot-key wrapper now; they import `FlowCredentialChannel`, so `@objectstack/dogfood` gains that workspace dependency (one lockfile entry).
- **Ablations this round** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` wrap mode, under the verify lock, at `507fcc8d`, whose tree is identical to `175740fd`, the reworded commit below the final merge; each restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

| # | Put back | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A9 | the bind regardless of the seal (`if (incumbent !== null) this.bindPackagelessActivation(…)`) | 5: both engine boot-convergence cases and the three real-kernel boot orders |
| A11 | no shared-name guard in `store()` (`const shared = undefined`) | 1: the SQLite shared-name refusal (the saves) |
| A12 | no shared-name guard in `promote()` | 1: the same test (the publish) |
| A13 | every source treated as reading by package (`const scoped = true`) | 1: the S3 engine test |
| A14 | an override arm with no `holder` under two slots takes the loader's by-name owner | 1: the N1 line in the environment-body test |

The round-1 and round-2 ablations A1–A8 (on #32091) cover code this round left unchanged.
